name: PARK SEUNGJUN
intro: I work across robotic installation, moving image, artificial intelligence, and Korean metal inlay, tracing how time, labor, ritual, and care take material form.
about: My practice moves between robotic installation, moving image, artificial intelligence, and Korean metal inlay. I am interested in moments when technical systems are encountered as bodies, rituals, and relationships.
availability: Selected works, research notes, and works in progress.
